attack_techniques: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Bypass User Account Control (T1548.002)
attackers_goals: Gain higher privileges by bypassing the User Account Control (UAC).
description: Creation or modification of these registry keys can cause the execution of the specified programs, bypassing UAC.
investigative_actions: Check the registry data modified for a potentially malicious command line. Look for processes running matching the command line for malicious activity.
